ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Introduction to Computer Simulation Methods The purpose of this course is to provide an introduction to the field of computer simulations in materials science. After a general introduction of central concepts, both the Monte Carlo method and the molecular dynamics method will be explained and illustrated by means of a number of examples. The focus of this class lies on understanding the various methods and on obtaining hands-on experience via the use of a generic molecular dynamics package. All students will have access to a special computing cluster to perform calculations with this package.
